description: Current YES/NO orderbook (bids + asks with size, in cents) for a market ticker. Use to see live liquidity depth before judging whether an edge is tradable. Returns sorted price/quantity levels.

depth.description: Levels to return per side (default 5, max 100)

name: kalshi_orderbook

levels_available.description: Untrimmed ladder depth per side, so a thin book can be told from a trimmed one

no_bids.description: NO side bid levels (best, i.e. highest, first)

price_cents.description: Bid price in cents (full-precision, rounded to a whole cent)

price_dollars.description: Bid price in dollars at Kalshi's full precision

note.description: Explanation of price encoding and probability calculation

quoted.description: false when nobody is resting an order on either side (Kalshi answers the same for a ticker that does not exist)

yes_bids.description: YES side bid levels (best, i.e. highest, first)

price_cents.description: Bid price in cents (full-precision, rounded to a whole cent)

price_dollars.description: Bid price in dollars at Kalshi's full precision

title: Kalshi Orderbook
